findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - the Python starter smoke runs test_3_the_python_web_app_uses_the_same_libraries.
The Python caller at lines 257–259 supplies an expected message ending in a period, but ESLint's [stylish formatter](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/blob/main/lib/cli-engine/formatters/stylish.js) strips trailing periods. Consequently, this assertion fails even when lint correctly rejects the import. The replaced test explicitly used removesuffix(".") for this reason. Restore that normalization or inspect structured diagnostics.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - the repository suite runs test_2_client_signoff_requires_a_complete_canvas[starter-screen].
Deleting this file leaves a live fixture dependency: tests/test_signoff_design.py:134 calls _client with seed_starter=True, and tests/test_proto_signoff.py:101–102 reads this exact template. That case now raises FileNotFoundError during setup before reaching its sign-off assertion. Update the fixture to construct its own screen while retaining the command-level check.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - pull request checks validate the shipped pending screen specs.
The actual Playwright collection check is behind FORGE_STARTER_LIVE, but every job setting that variable selects explicit test files and omits tests/test_noscreens_rules.py; see .github/workflows/starter-smoke.yml:48 and :76. The ordinary suite leaves the variable unset, so this test returns here after checking filenames and config text. Thus the named proof never verifies that enabling the specs successfully lists their tests. Include both starter parameters in a live CI invocation.
